kinds.title: To me, when I feel…
kinds.line: Shown after you log one of these feelings, if you'd like to read it

texts: Remind yourself what has helped before.
What would you want to hear right now?
What do you know that's easy to forget when you feel this way?

kinds.title: To me, when I doubt myself
kinds.line: For the days you're not sure you can

texts: Something you got through that once felt like too much.
What do the people who know you well see in you?
A time you did it anyway.

kinds.title: To me, when I'm proud
kinds.line: To make a good moment last

texts: What did it take to get here?
What do you want to remember about how this feels?

kinds.title: To me, on a hard day
kinds.line: For whatever kind of hard day comes

texts: You don't have to fix today. Here's what I'd like you to know:
Small things that have helped before.
Someone you could call, and what you might say.

kinds.title: To me, on a day in the future
kinds.line: A letter that waits until the date you choose

texts: Where are you now, and where do you hope you'll be?
What's worrying you at the moment that might look different by then?
Something you hope you're still doing.

generalStarters: Remind yourself what has helped before.
What would you want to hear?
What do you know that you forget when things are hard?
writeTip: Your own words, in your own voice. Only you will see this.
hardFeelingTip: Write to the you who is struggling, as someone who cares about them.
offer: You left yourself a note for days like this. Would you like to read it?
dontShowWhenIntense: Don't show this when the feeling is very strong
